triage-bot: alert: elevated_tls_handshake_failures detected on /v1/stream at 2026-06-10T05:12:00Z · spike in 5xx and client handshake alerts

zoe (sre): opening follow-up thread — intermittent cross-region TLS handshakes failing (ap-northeast -> eu-west) seen during morning rollout. creating canonical action list here.

hamid (networking): quick triage: control-plane shows a brief route-manager reconciliation at 05:10:22; some flows look like they were remapped while ClientHello in flight. suspect route rehome race + cert roll timing.

will (eng-runtime): logs show TLS alert 40 and occasional "peer cert unknown" where SNI is present. also saw elevated conn reset counters on egress proxies. attaching short sample in artifacts.

zoe (sre): repro snippet for infra to stress test from ap-northeast: 
```
kubectl run -it --rm testraw --image=curlimages/curl --restart=Never -- sh -c "for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -sS -H 'Host: api.redwood.internal' https://api.redwood.internal/health || echo fail:$i; sleep 0.2; done"
```

hamid (networking): action X1: capture 20m tcpdump on egress-ap-northeast-1 focusing on TLS ClientHello SNI + server cert CN. owner: hamid. ETA: 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC.

will (eng-runtime): action X2 (mitigation): enable 600ms jittered backoff on cross-region retries and flip short session stickiness for cross-region routes (4h window). owner: will. ETA: 2026-06-10 06:00 UTC. will roll to 30% -> 100% over 15m.

zoe (sre): action X3: add lightweight TLS fields to proxy spans (SNI, cert_serial, route_instance) and create temp dashboard. owner: zoe. ETA: 2026-06-11 09:00 UTC.

cloud-eng: action X4: open provider case requesting BGP/AS-path trace and NAT gateway ephemeral port counters for the window. owner: cloud-eng. ETA: 2026-06-14 18:00 UTC.

carla (product): action X5: draft short customer-facing note and support playbook for any impacted tenants. owner: carla. ETA: 2026-06-10 18:00 UTC.

hamid (networking): initial pcap note: saw one trace where same client IP's handshake landed on two different backend cert CNs within ~27s. saving capture to shared folder.

will (eng-runtime): observation: KV cache cold spikes during rollout amplify handshake window by ~30ms — adding Optimize team to RCA.

zoe (sre): scheduled sync 2026-06-10 13:30 UTC to review pcaps, telemetry, and provider response. marking this thread as canonical follow-up for the incident. please drop artifacts, PRs, and provider case ID here. :white_check_mark:

triage-bot: incident state -> mitigated (2026-06-10 06:18 UTC)
